scope: Isolated S1 shared-process views in multiprocess mode. Two popups share the affected view's content process. Fixtures cover ordinary close of one shared view, child exit, host SIGKILL, and a close-then-kill teardown race. No product dependency or runtime configuration changes.

provenance.origin: Another session wrote the fixtures and the closed-view guard in the main checkout and stopped before its final run. Its uncommitted diff was applied onto 4001e29 with a three-way merge. Conflicts in the runner and one patch hunk header were resolved by hand.
provenance.merge_check: Prepared sources equal the 4001e29 sources plus exactly the 20 source lines of the other session's preparation.

earlier_failed_run.note: The other session's only recorded run, before it added the closed-view guard. Retained as found; its exact binary and sources are not reproduced here.

results.scope: Experimental engine scope, host allocation gate, script-thread unwind, final-handle release, explicit engine shutdown, queued execution cancellation, interruption of running JavaScript, content-process exit and forced kill in multiprocess mode, shared-process view revocation and ordinary sibling close, and callback and delegate unwind safety. Backend disconnection, failures before document construction, and remaining replacement audits remain open.

baseline.head: 4001e29
baseline.note: The backend evidence records three passing runs in each mode at this checkpoint, immediately before this change.

configuration.shared_process_check: A child barrier reports its OS process id to the host. All three views must report the same id, which differs from the host id.
configuration.race_order: The third view queues eight callbacks and closes while the shared child is blocked. After a constellation flush, the host kills the child before it can acknowledge pipeline exit.

limitations: Multiprocess evidence uses unsandboxed children on macOS arm64 with software rendering.
